thread:
sarah (support): FYI just got an escalation from Acme — their integration started failing for function/tool calls after the latest sdk patch. They see a schema validation error from our router when calling `get_customer_profile` from Python. curl works. customer pasted error: 

`Error: schema validation failed for tool get_customer_profile: parameter 'filters' expected object, got array`

sarah (support): Attaching the payload they used (redacted) — they say TS client works sometimes, Go fails consistently, Python fails when they pass a tuple.

sarah (support): Python snippet they used:
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key=... )
# they do positional args for filters as a tuple
resp = client.call_tool("get_customer_profile", ("region", "EU"))
print(resp)
```

sarah (support): TS example from them (works intermittently):
```ts
const client = new RedwoodClient({apiKey: process.env.KEY});
// they pass object normally
await client.callTool('get_customer_profile', { filters: { region: 'EU' } });
```

sarah (support): Go repro they sent (fails):
```go
client.CallTool("get_customer_profile", []string{"region","EU"})
```

mike (eng-sdk): Thanks — looks like different SDKs have differing marshaling rules for positional vs keyword args. Our router expects a JSON object for `filters` (schema says { type: object }). If SDK serializes a positional tuple/array it comes through as JSON array which validator rejects.

leah (eng-ml): Are we sure this is only positional vs keyword? Could also be key-order or sort_keys edge in Python's json.dumps. But the error says 'expected object, got array' so array -> object mismatch.

alana (eng-backend): I pulled the logs for the failed requests. Verified incoming payloads: Python request body shows "tool_args": ["region","EU"] while TS request shows "tool_args": {"filters":{"region":"EU"}}. Router schema validator sees first as array and rejects.

mike (eng-sdk): Repro locally. Quick note: older python sdk accidentally converted single tuple arg into list at top-level instead of wrapping into dict when user called client.call_tool(name, args) vs client.call_tool(name, kwargs=...). The TS/Go SDK conventions differ. We should document but also patch so positional single-key kwargs aren't mis-serialized.

sarah (support): Customer asked for workaround — they can't change code everywhere. What can we offer now?

mike (eng-sdk): Short-term workaround for customers: call with explicit keyword form in Python: `client.call_tool('get_customer_profile', kwargs={'filters': {'region': 'EU'}})` or use `client.call_tool('get_customer_profile', **{'filters': ('region','EU')})`? Actually second might still produce tuple->array. So recommend explicit dict. For TS/Go ask them to pass object.

alana (eng-backend): We can also add a tolerant server-side shim to convert top-level arrays into objects for tool calls that expect an object — map arrays of alternating key/value pairs into object if length is even and keys are strings. Risky but helpful as temporary mitigation. I'll spin up a small patch behind a feature flag.

leah (eng-ml): Also add a clearer validation error to include `tool_args` payload in debug logs (redacted) so support can triage faster.

mike (eng-sdk): I'll prepare a 1-line change in python sdk: always coerce kwargs into dict when passed as positional tuple/list if function signature's first param is named `filters` or if the tool's declared schema expects object. Safer approach: SDK should consult model's tool schema (we expose it in catalog cached locally) and serialize accordingly. Implement quick fix: if a single positional arg and schema type == object -> wrap into {"filters": arg} only when the tool param name is known.

sarah (support): Customer wants ETA. Can we give one?

mike (eng-sdk): Hotfix to python SDK published as patch release in ~2 hrs (0.12.3) with explicit coercion. Server-side tolerant shim behind flag in staging now, can enable prod in ~6 hrs after smoke tests.

alana (eng-backend): Deployed shim to canary behind ff `shim-tool-arg-array-to-object`. Observed ~3% of tool calls hit the shim path in the canary traffic — all converted successfully. No errors so far. :+1:

sarah (support): Sent customer the workaround and ETA + asked if they can enable named kwargs as a stopgap. They replied they can patch some services but not the entire fleet, so server-side shim will help.

mike (eng-sdk): Follow-ups:
- Add unit tests for python sdk for positional->object coercion (cover tuple, list, dataclass inputs).
- Add docs note and a deprecation path: warn on next release when pattern detected.

leah (eng-ml): And I'll update the function router validator to include a friendlier message: "expected object for parameter 'filters' — received array. If you intended to pass an object, ensure SDK uses keyword args or upgrade to SDK >= 0.12.3".

sarah (support): Filed internal incident ticket and customer escalation. Customer replied :eyes: and said thanks for quick turnaround.

ci-bot: build/python-sdk-0.12.3 started (job #422).

mike (eng-sdk): I'll post release notes and link the patch here once green. Next update in thread in ~3hrs. :wave:
